spans.s: A magnet attracts an iron piece without actually doing anything. The puruṣa of the Sāmkhya philosophy makes the Prakṛti active without any action on his part. This maxim is applicable to a man who gets things done without doing anything. --
Ex. ईश्वरस्य सुहृदः स्वयं निर्धना अपि तदीयेन धनेन धन फलभाजस्तद्वत्। --

That which is obtained without any formal request is Ayācitaka. Many a time, the devotees are poor but they can achieve the fruit of the wealth by virtue of their devotion. This is what the maxim emphasizes on.
